about_the_game:
💟Story Background💟

Long ago, humans used a power known as Lustan to restrain the powerful monster girls and peacefully coexist with them for hundreds of years.

However, for unknown reasons, humanity gradually lost the ability to wield Lustan.
The monster girls fell into a state of “chaos” and began attacking humans, causing civilization to collapse.

You are an ordinary boy living in the decaying human kingdom of Solavien.

One day, by chance, you awaken the long-lost power of Lustan—allowing you to capture the rampaging monster girls.

In order to avoid being "drained dry" by the monster girls flocking to you, you must go on the offensive—venturing into the four major regions. Capture monster girls and form contracts with them to find a way to stop the chaos.

At the same time, you begin to uncover the truth behind why you were able to awaken the power of Lustan—and why humanity lost it in the first place.

💟Explore a Land of Ever-Changing Terrain💟

Each time you embark on an adventure, the map will be procedurally generated, giving you a brand-new route and battle environment every time.

Adapt, stay alert, and survive in this unpredictable world!

💟Bullet Hell on All Sides💟

This land is teeming with monsters—some may appear pitifully cute, but when they unleash overwhelming barrages of bullets, you'd better be ready!
Luckily, you have a unique ability—you can capture any monster in the game and make them fight for you!

Every monster has its own distinct shooting style. Make smart use of their abilities to gain the upper hand in battle!

💟Evolve!💟

Build bonds with your Puchimon and transform them into charming humanoid forms!
Strengthen your relationship and unlock rich, exclusive events!

After evolution, your Puchimon won't just become more alluring—they’ll also gain tremendous power in battle!

  • Build a bond with your Puchimon and “awaken” them into stunning humanoid forms!

  • Deepen your connection to unlock a variety of unique character events!

  • Once evolved, your Puchimon won’t just look more alluring — they’ll also become much stronger in battle!

💟Game Features💟

  • 7 unique Puchimon await your capture! Each pet has its own distinct form and personality.

  • 3 Puchimon can evolve into seductive humanoid forms, with 2 featuring exclusive storylines.

  • Customize your gear freely to create endless combinations and dynamic bullet-hell combat!

  • Explore ever-changing dungeons, where every adventure offers a fresh new challenge!

In this version, we’ve prepared a forest stage and seven types of Puchimon.

We plan to continue adding new battle stages and more Puchimon in future updates.
